name: Sirkka Nieminen
bio:
Sirkka Nieminen's career has been anything but conventional. Leaving behind a promising career in the Finnish police force, she found her true calling in the high-octane world of motorsport security. Her no-nonsense approach and meticulous attention to detail quickly made her a valuable asset to smaller racing outfits before catching the eye of Team Penske.

Sirkka views security not just as preventing threats, but as an integral part of race strategy. She believes a secure environment allows the team to focus entirely on performance. Known for her calm demeanor under pressure, Sirkka is a pragmatic problem-solver. Her experience working with diverse personalities and handling complex logistical challenges makes her uniquely suited to managing the multifaceted security demands of a top-tier racing team. Her blend of creative problem solving and experience makes her a force to be reckoned with.

What sets Sirkka apart is her ability to balance the need for strict protocols with the human element. She understands that a security system is only as strong as the people who operate it, and she fosters a culture of trust and open communication within her team. This approach has earned her the respect of both her colleagues and competitors.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob with a slight wave
physical.description: Sirkka is a strong, sturdy woman with a watchful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool on her keychain.
Insists on doing a full security sweep of the garage before every race, regardless of prior checks.
Has a habit of humming quietly to herself when deep in thought.
